originalAlarm.description: Potential leak of memory pointed to by 'eckey'

model:
(define-fun SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto () Bool
  true)
(define-fun HAVE_ECC () Bool
  true)
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: When HAVE_ECC is defined, eckey is allocated via malloc(sizeof(int)) at line 10 but the function returns at line 24 without ever calling free(eckey). This is a genuine memory leak. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for 35ae2e259e4.c documents exactly this MemoryLeak (eckey allocated but never freed) with config HAVE_ECC. The tool detects the same bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: The presence condition simplifies to HAVE_ECC (both variants have HAVE_ECC), which matches the vbdb config exactly — the eckey variable is only declared and allocated inside #ifdef HAVE_ECC.
